title: Reduce weight decay regularization
description: Reduced WEIGHT_DECAY from 0.2 to 0.1 to test if baseline is over-regularized
reflection: Hypothesis was incorrect: reducing weight decay hurt generalization (val_bpb 0.998232 vs baseline 0.996598, +0.0016 worse). The baseline WD=0.2 provides beneficial regularization for this model/task combination. Regularization is not the constraint; deeper changes to architecture or optimization strategy are needed. The baseline remains robust against orthogonal perturbations.
